title: Prediction and Quantification of Individual Athletic Performance of Runners
claims: The Riegel formula predicts performance by fitting a constant to each runner and fixing the distance exponent at 1.06.
The paper treats the formula as a model of endurance performance rather than a guarantee of future race times.

verification.note: PMC 全文可读：正文写 Riegel 幂律要求 log t = 1.06 log s + c，λ1=1.06 对每位跑者固定、λ2 为跑者常数；并指出个体成绩会非线性偏离世界纪录幂律。

claimVerification.note: “The Riegel power law … log t = 1.06 log s + c”。
论文把幂律列为模型/基线，并说明个体偏离。
